lines.text: GTA 6 just got a ninety-nine on Metacritic!
That ties the highest score any game has EVER had there.
The only other game up there? Zelda: Ocarina of Time, from nineteen ninety-eight!
lines.caps: The only *other one: | *Ocarina of Time, | from *1998.

lines.text: It even beats Rockstar's own records, because GTA 4 sits at ninety-eight, and GTA 5 at ninety-seven.
And this is not one lucky review. More than a hundred critics went into that number!
The score can still move a little as more reviews come in, so keep an eye on it tonight.
lines.caps: It can *still move | as more *reviews | come in.

lines.text: If you pre-loaded, the wait is almost over, because it reportedly unlocks at midnight on PS5 and Xbox Series.
Part two is your call. A: what reviewers loved most. Or B: what they did not like?
